answer: One concrete defense is bank-account attestation: each identity must link one verified bank account, confirmed by micro-deposits returned from that same account. Banks check identity, so an account is neither free nor anonymous, and the network rejects a second identity presenting the same account. Like a vault, it is a single-key store: one key opens one identity, a duplicate is refused. A sybil farmer therefore needs a real, KYC-checked account per fake, paying fees and leaving a paper trail. A reef of verified identities grows slowly, so reaching the zenith costs one real account per fake.
